description: Makita is the leading manufacturer of professional power tools on the market. The DMP181Z is a cordless Inflator, powered by 18V Li-ion LXT slide type battery (not include) to deliver up to 1.100 kPa, 161 PSI maximum air pressure and 22 litres per minute at 200 kPa, 11 litres at 700 kPa and 7 litres at 1,100 kPa air discharge. The DMP181Z is ideal for inflating tyres of cars, bicycles, sports balls and more and is equipped with main power switch with auto power off to minimise accidental start-up during transporting, trigger switch, 3 inflation modes for high speed, low speed and ball mode, digital pressure gauge, easy to grip handle for user convenience and LED job light for easier operation in poor light conditions. The DMP181Z features protection from overheating, auto-stop at pre-set target pressure, memory function to remember the pressure last time the DMP181Z was used before turning the power off and air release function; in case of over-inflating, holding the air release button will release air. This function is not available when using the British adapter. The DMP181Z is equipped with battery protection circuit designed to protect the battery from damages due to overheating, over-discharge and overload current, adapter holder and is supplied with various valve adapters that can be stored on the machine. The DMP181Z is not compatible with G-Series batteries. 1 year manufacturer warranty with a further 2 years when registered within 30 days of purchase. This guarantee does not apply where non-genuine or recommended parts or accessories are fitted to the tool. The use of non-genuine or compatible batteries and chargers with Makita tools will invalidate the Makita guarantee for our tools.
